synthesis.body: For a Fontsource variable font, the package's default `index.css` export registers only the wght axis. Optical sizing (opsz) — and other axes — live in separate stylesheets (e.g. `@fontsource-variable/source-serif-4/opsz.css`). Wiring the bare package name into Starlight customCss silently drops optical sizing: the family renders, font-variation-settings 'opsz' does nothing, and nothing fails. Import the axis-carrying stylesheet explicitly and verify the axis appears in the built @font-face rules.

title: Fontsource variable packages: default index.css is wght-only
